outcome: Composite adverse maternal outcome (postpartum transfusion, endometritis, wound/perineal infection/separation, venous thromboembolism, hysterectomy, admission to intensive care unit, and/or death)
cohort: Women with singleton deliveries at ≥23 weeks of gestation
finding: Chorioamnionitis was associated with increased odds of adverse maternal outcomes in women who underwent caesarean delivery, regardless of other factors, but not in women who had a vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Chorioamnionitis was associated with higher odds of the composite adverse maternal outcome with caesarean delivery but not after vaginal delivery.
